title: Uniqueness of normalized diagonal conormal derivations on all open sections
statement: For a scheme morphism f : X → S [def-pc-scheme], any two relative derivations D₁,D₂ into its diagonal conormal [def-sc-diagonal-conormal] satisfying the prescribed difference formula [lem-sc-diagonal-conormal-derivation-exists] agree on every section over every open U ⊆ X. No affine-chart or separatedness hypothesis is needed.

proof.text: For any open U put W = p₁⁻¹(U) ∩ p₂⁻¹(U). Since δ ≫ pᵢ = id, U = δ⁻¹(W). For a ∈ Γ(X,U), b = p₂* a − p₁* a is killed by δ.app W: apply Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE and subtract the equal composite maps.

The proved upstream theorem Scheme.Modules.range_map_kernelι identifies sections killed by δ.app W with the image of the actual sheaf-module kernel inclusion, giving a kernel section s mapping to b. Apply both normalization hypotheses to this same W,s. Both values are equal to the same restricted tensor-pullback unit on s; transitivity gives the result. No existence theorem for a derivation is used.

proof_origin.place: Tags 08S2, 01KJ and 01R3; checked online in the independent second reading on 2026-10-13. For uniqueness, the difference-formula argument is made directly in Lean using the existing sectionwise kernel theorem.

lean.statement:
theorem diagonalConormal_affine_sections_unique (f : X ⟶ S)
    (U : X.Opens)
    (D₁ D₂ : (diagonalConormal f).val.Derivation' f.pullbackPresheafToPresheaf)
    (h₁ : IsDiagonalConormalDerivation f D₁)
    (h₂ : IsDiagonalConormalDerivation f D₂) :
    ∀ a : Γ(X, U), D₁.d (X := op U) a = D₂.d (X := op U) a
